title: GitHub - tubeagentkit/youtube-transcript-api-python: YouTube Transcript API Python SDK: get YouTube video transcripts, search YouTube, list channel and playlist videos with one typed client. No Google API key.
snippet:
The official Python SDK (`getyoutubetranscript`) for the [GetYouTubeTranscript](https://getyoutubetranscript.com) YouTube Transcript API. Get YouTube video transcripts, captions and subtitles (optionally with per-line timestamps) in Python without a Google API key, yt-dlp, or a headless browser. Get YouTube transcripts, search videos and channels, resolve channel handles, browse a channel's full upload history (videos, Shorts or live streams), list a channel's playlists and community posts, fetch its banner, search inside a channel, pull playlist contents, get related videos and estimated dislikes, and check your credit balance, all with one typed client.

Every request needs an API key. There are two ways to get one:
1. **Dashboard** - sign up at [getyoutubetranscript.com](https://getyoutubetranscript.com). Free tier: 100 credits, no card required.
2. **Self-serve, in code** - use the `signup`/`verify_signup` helpers below. No key required for either call.
```
from getyoutubetranscript import signup, verify_signup
signup("you@example.com")          # sends a 6-digit code, valid 10 minutes
# ... read the code from your inbox ...
api_key = verify_signup("you@example.com", "123456")  # -> "sk_live_..."
```

Every method costs 1 credit unless noted "free" below. Failed and rate-limited requests are never charged. All methods raise `GetYouTubeTranscriptError` on failure - see Error handling.

### Account
```
client.get_credits()  # free - plan_credits_left, topup_credits_left, total_credits_left (the two combined), plan, rate_limit_per_minute
```

The trade-off: it is a paid API with a free tier (each request uses credits), while `youtube-transcript-api` is free to run if you handle the blocking yourself.

title: YouTube transcript API: official limits and real options
snippet:
YouTube has no official API that returns the transcript of any video. The YouTube Data API's captions.download method costs 200 quota units and requires permission to edit the video, so it only works on videos you manage. For public videos, developers use the unofficial youtube-transcript-api Python library, which YouTube often blocks on cloud servers, or a paid service such as Supadata (1 credit per transcript, plans from $5 a month billed yearly) or Scrape Creators, which sells prepaid credit packs.

| Option | Works on | Price | Main catch |
|---|---|---|---|
| YouTube Data API captions | Videos you can edit | Free within 10,000 quota units a day | Owner permission and OAuth required |
| youtube-transcript-api (Python) | Public videos with captions | Free, MIT license | Uses an undocumented endpoint. YouTube blocks most cloud provider IPs, so production use needs rotating residential proxies. |
| Supadata | YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X videos | 100 free credits a month. Basic $5 a month billed yearly for 300 credits, Pro $17 for 3,000. 1 credit per transcript. | Monthly credits do not roll over. AI-generated transcripts cost 2 credits per minute. |
| Scrape Creators | YouTube and other social platforms | 100 free credits, then prepaid credit packs that cost less per credit as they get larger | Age-restricted videos return 403. Purchased credits never expire. |
| Gemini API with a YouTube URL | Public videos only | Preview feature that Google lists at no charge for now | The model writes the text from the video. Free-tier projects are capped at 8 hours of YouTube video a day. |

Then ask: "Get the transcript of this YouTube video and summarize the main points."
The agent searches the catalog and reads the endpoint price for free. It then runs the call with a credit ceiling. If the endpoint is off for your workspace, the agent sends an access request first. The Free plan allows up to 5 tool calls a minute.

title: The Best YouTube Transcript APIs in 2026: 7 Options Compared
snippet:
- **Pricing.** One-time credit packs: $9 for 2,000, $29 for 10,000, $79 for 50,000. That is $4.50 down to $1.58 per 1,000 transcripts. Credits never expire. 200 free credits on signup, no card.
- **Billing.** Only HTTP 200 responses use a credit. Videos without captions, private or members-only videos, and rate-limit responses are free.

## 2. TranscriptAPI
A hosted YouTube API with a large cache, covering transcripts, search, channels and playlists, with an MCP server.
- **Speed.** Very fast when its cache already has the video. In our uncached test the median was 2.41 s, and 15% of first requests returned `408` and needed the documented retry.
- **Pricing** (checked September 26, 2026). $5 a month or $54 a year for 1,000 credits a month, with top-ups at $2.50 per 1,000 (monthly) or $1.50 (annual). 100 free credits.
- **Good fit** for steady volume on popular videos, at a low price per credit.

- **Pricing** (checked October 6, 2026). Monthly plans: $5 for 300 credits, $17 for 3,000, $47 for 30,000, and larger tiers. Credits do not roll over. A transcript from existing captions is 1 credit; an AI-generated one is 2 credits per minute of video. 100 free credits a month.

The [youtube-transcript-api](https://github.com/jdepoix/youtube-transcript-api) library fetches captions directly from YouTube, with no API key. It is free, well maintained, and works well on your own machine.
- **The catch.** YouTube blocks most IP addresses that belong to cloud providers. Its README warns that on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure and similar hosts you will most likely get `RequestBlocked` or `IpBlocked`, and it suggests paying for rotating residential proxies. We wrote up what that looks like on [AWS](/blog/how-to-fix-youtube-transcript-api-ip-blocked-aws), [Google Cloud](/blog/how-to-fix-youtube-transcript-api-ip-blocked-gcp) and [Vercel, Render and Railway](/blog/youtube-transcript-api-blocked-on-vercel-render-railway).

## Cost per 1,000 transcripts
| | Lowest entry | Price per 1,000 | Credits expire |
|---|---|---|---|
| YTAPI | $9 one-time | $4.50 (2,000 pack) to $1.58 (50,000 pack) | Never |
| TranscriptAPI | $5 a month | $5.00 for the first 1,000; top-ups $2.50 or $1.50 | Monthly credits reset |
| Supadata | $5 a month | $16.67 (Basic) to $1.57 (Mega, if you use all 30,000) | Monthly |
| Apify actors | Apify plan | About $0.70 to $10, by actor | Per your Apify plan |
| youtube-transcript-api, yt-dlp | Free | Free, plus proxies on servers | n/a |
| YouTube Data API | Free |

title: How to Connect YouTube to ChatGPT (Transcripts and Search)
snippet:
Before getting started, ensure you have:
- A ChatGPT Plus or Team subscription (required for Developer Mode)
- A TranscriptAPI account ([sign up free](https://transcriptapi.com))
- 10 minutes to complete the setup

| **TranscriptAPI MCP connector** | A hosted YouTube transcript API exposed to ChatGPT as an MCP tool | Nothing to install or host; OAuth-based setup (this guide); same infrastructure as TranscriptAPI’s REST API (49ms median response time, 15M+ transcripts/month); also adds search, channel, and playlist tools | Requires a TranscriptAPI account and credits after the free tier; requires ChatGPT Plus or Team for Developer Mode (currently beta) |

**Do I need a paid ChatGPT plan?**
Yes — ChatGPT’s Developer Mode, which is required to add custom MCP connectors, is currently available on ChatGPT Plus and Team plans only (see Prerequisites above).
**Does the connector cost anything beyond my ChatGPT subscription?**
TranscriptAPI is metered separately from ChatGPT: new accounts get 100 free credits, and paid plans start at $5/month. Fetching a transcript costs 1 credit; listing a channel’s latest videos is free. See [MCP credit usage and rate limits](https://transcriptapi.com/docs/mcp/#credit-usage--rate-limits) for the full breakdown.

title: GitHub - ytapi/youtube-skills: YouTube transcripts, search, channels and summaries for AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes). Powered by YTAPI.
snippet:
The first time Claude uses a YTAPI tool, run `/mcp` and sign in to your YTAPI account (or create one: 200 free credits, no card). No API key needed. The plugin lives in [`plugins/ytapi`](/ytapi/youtube-skills/blob/main/plugins/ytapi).

| [`ytapi-youtube-transcript`](/ytapi/youtube-skills/blob/main/skills/ytapi-youtube-transcript/SKILL.md) | Transcripts and subtitles: text, Markdown, timestamped JSON, SRT, VTT, any language |

The skills read the key from `YTAPI_API_KEY`. If it is not set, the agent offers to create a free account for you: you give it your email address and the 6-digit code we send you, and it stores the key. No browser and no card. Or create a key yourself at [ytapi.dev](https://ytapi.dev/app/api-keys?utm_source=skill&utm_medium=readme).
New accounts get 200 free credits. One successful request uses one credit (video basic info and search suggestions are free); failed requests are free. Until you buy a credit pack, a key can make 1 request per second and 100 per day. Packs start at $9 for 2,000 credits and never expire: [pricing](https://ytapi.dev/?utm_source=skill&utm_medium=readme#pricing).
